reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: p0030/p0035 are ordinary licence-scope restrictions ('not use the Work except as authorized'), which is not a non-compete or field-of-use restraint on our business activities.

p0133 is a mutual, reciprocal employee non-hire for one year post-term — a distinct restrictive-covenant category (non-solicit), binding both parties equally, so it is not a Customer non-compete under this rule.
No redline or counterparty comment was produced, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') also passes.

Rationale is accurate and appropriately notes the negative sweeps ('compet', 'exclusive', 'shall not develop/market/sell/engage') and the independent-development carve-out in the confidentiality clause, consistent with the preferred position of no restriction at all.
